MR Safety
The Willow Infusion Pump is MR Conditional. A person with the Willow Infusion Pump may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Willow Infusion Pump
Device Configuration MRI mode ON
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 3T only
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 300 gauss/cm
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.5 W/kg
head SAR ≤ 1 W/kg
Scan Duration Scan for up to 10 minutes. Followed by a wait time of 10 minutes.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
